predicates.name: Contraction Existence
predicates.semantic_definition: At least 2 valid contraction waves are detected in the base.
predicates.missing_data_behavior: If base cannot be analyzed, returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA
predicates.temporal_semantics: Wave search strictly bounded within base lookback

predicates.name: Valid Contraction Sequence & Bounds
predicates.semantic_definition: Contraction count is between 2 and 4 (up to 6), and initial wave depth does not exceed 45%.
predicates.numeric_representation: Wave count and initial depth ratio
predicates.boundary_behavior: Depth > 45% fails as base is too loose / damaged
predicates.missing_data_behavior: Returns NOT_APPLICABLE if no contractions found

predicates.name: Pivot Price Level Defined
predicates.semantic_definition: A concrete resistance pivot level is identified at the high of the final narrow contraction wave.
predicates.formula: pivot_price is not None and pivot_price > 0
predicates.boundary_behavior: PASS if numeric pivot defined; FAIL if undefined or zero
predicates.missing_data_behavior: Returns FAIL if base has no identifiable pivot
predicates.temporal_semantics: High of final contraction prior to evaluation_as_of

predicates.name: Price Proximity to Pivot
predicates.semantic_definition: Current price is in the buyable tactical zone: within -5% to +2% of the pivot level.
predicates.boundary_behavior: PASS if inside [-0.05, +0.02]; FAIL if extended (> +2%) or lagging (< -5%)
predicates.missing_data_behavior: Returns NOT_APPLICABLE if pivot is undefined
predicates.temporal_semantics: Price as of evaluation_as_of session close relative to pivot

predicates.name: Prior Primary Uptrend Advance
predicates.semantic_definition: Verifies that the base is preceded by a primary advance of at least +30% from a prior consolidation low.
predicates.missing_data_behavior: Returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA if prior history unavailable
predicates.temporal_semantics: Calculated across lookback period prior to base formation start

predicates.name: Progressive Contraction Tightening
predicates.semantic_definition: Each successive contraction wave exhibits a strictly smaller percentage depth: Depth_k < Depth_{k-1}.
predicates.formula: all(contraction_depths[i] < contraction_depths[i-1] for i in range(1, len(contraction_depths)))
predicates.boundary_behavior: PASS if strictly decreasing; FAIL if any wave expands or equals preceding wave

predicates.name: Stage 1 Basing Phase Diagnostic
predicates.semantic_definition: Asset trades in a lateral channel with a flat 200 SMA following a prior decline.

predicates.name: Stage 2 Advancing Phase Confirmation
predicates.semantic_definition: Asset trades in a structural Stage 2 advance with upward trending 200 SMA and higher highs/lows.
predicates.boundary_behavior: PASS if above rising 200 SMA; FAIL if below or flat/declining
predicates.temporal_semantics: Evaluated as of current session close

predicates.name: Stage 3 Topping Phase Diagnostic
predicates.semantic_definition: Asset shows flattening 200 SMA after substantial advance with high churn.

predicates.name: Stage 4 Declining Phase Diagnostic
predicates.semantic_definition: Asset trades below a declining 200 SMA in a secular markdown.

predicates.name: Sufficient Historical Sessions
predicates.semantic_definition: Ensures minimum 200 completed daily trading sessions exist prior to evaluation_as_of for 200 SMA calculation.
predicates.missing_data_behavior: Returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA, never coerced to FAIL
predicates.temporal_semantics: Evaluated strictly on bars closed prior to or at evaluation_as_of

predicates.name: Minervini 8-Point Trend Template
predicates.semantic_definition: Verifies Stage 2 alignment: Price > 150 & 200 SMA; 150 SMA > 200 SMA; 200 SMA slope >= 0 (22 days); 50 SMA > 150 & 200 SMA; Price > 50 SMA; Price >= 30% above 52w low; Price within 25% of 52w high.
predicates.formula: (close > sma_150 and close > sma_200) and (sma_150 > sma_200) and (sma_200_slope_22 >= 0) and (sma_50 > sma_150 and sma_50 > sma_200) and (close > sma_50) and (close >= low_52w * 1.30) and (close >= high_52w * 0.75)
predicates.boundary_behavior: All 7 primary conditions must hold; any failure returns FAIL
predicates.missing_data_behavior: If moving averages cannot be computed, returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA
predicates.temporal_semantics: Moving averages and 52w highs/lows computed only over admissible bars

predicates.name: Volume Dry-Up on Final Contraction
predicates.semantic_definition: Average volume during the final contraction wave drops below 70% of 50-day SMA volume.
predicates.numeric_representation: Ratio of final wave volume to 50 SMA volume
predicates.missing_data_behavior: Returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA if volume history is missing or zero
predicates.temporal_semantics: Evaluated across bars of final contraction wave
